immunities: bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered
name: Wererat

traits.Shapechanger: The wererat can use its action to polymorph into a rat-humanoid hybrid or into a giant rat, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics are the same in each form.
traits.Keen Smell: The wererat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.note: Rat or hybrid form only. If the target is humanoid it must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with wererat lycanthropy.
